        - heading "Understand Complex Addition" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "Complex addition adds real parts together and imaginary parts together. In Complex Addition, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Addition: (a+bi)+(c+di)=(a+c)+(b+d)i. You can learn Complex Addition by trying one small example instead of long theory."
        - paragraph: Add component by component. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, ac electricity: Complex operations track magnitude and phase. Watch out: Adding a real part to an imaginary coefficient. Add real with real and imaginary with imaginary."
